newsitem.title: USA: Unity Bancorp Inc Q4 full results.
newsitem.headline: Unity Bancorp Inc Q4 full results.

text.p: Unity Bancorp Inc, parent of First Community Bank, reported an increase of 102.7 percent in fourth quarter earnings to $415.1 thousand from $204.8 thousand one year earlier. Respective earnings per share for the two periods grew 47.1 percent to $0.25 from $0.17.
Full year operating income, excluding non-recurring charges, rose 26 percent to $1.267 million as compared to $1.005 million in 1995. Operating earnings per share in 1996 rose to $0.89

from $0.83 in 1995. Net income for 1996 was reduced by a congressionally mandated, one-time charge during the third quarter of $370,000 to help recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund. Net income for 1996 Including the charge, was $1.044 million or $0.74 per share.

Total assets at year end 1996 were up 41.8 percent to $172.7 million, from the 1995 total of $121.8 million. During the same period, total deposits grew 38.3 percent to $153.6 million, from $111.0 million, and net loans jumped 65.7 percent to $96.9 million from $58.5 million.
Total equity at year end had grown to $18 million, a 112 percent increase over the $8.5 million reported one year earlier.
